title: A few flaws
text: A few flaws. [[VIDEOID:72337d16b5b070916fcb911d3650eb24]] I have another one of these that is a  different brand so I’m comparing the 2. This unit is much louder. When the heat is on, it whirs very loudly. Also, the heat comes out of the bottom. I prefer the heating element to be located at top. It radiates heat throughout the room differently and when you stand in front of it, you warm up better. This unit conducts electrical shock almost every time I touch it. And lastly, the legs and the hardware are very poorly made. Cheap plastic and tiny screws. The legs wobble after assembly. I love the look though and you can use it without the heat so it just had the pretty look of a fireplace. (But even that setting makes noise) Overall, this unit is just okay and I would not order it again.

product_metadata.title: TURBRO Suburbs TS23-H Electric Fireplace Heater – 22" Freestanding Portable Compact Stove with Realistic Flame Effect - CSA Certified, Overheating Protection - 1400W, Black
features: [Elegant Style] The European design of TS23-H brings you a retro feel suitable for any space like your bedroom, living room, or office. Stay cozy in the cold winter with this classic electric fireplace.

[Efficient Heater] With a 1400W / 4,780BTU heat output, you can have a warm fire without the mess and smoke of a real fireplace. It can heat up the room quickly and save money compared to a gas stove.

[Tasteful Decoration] Besides the European-style exterior, the realistic flame and logs of this unit also create a charming ambiance in your room. The top of the unit is flat and cool to touch, so you can decorate your stove with ornaments for the holidays.

[Easy as Pie] It only takes a few steps to get everything ready. By toggling the power switch and the temperature control knob, you can regulate the temperature easily. You can also turn off the heater and enjoy the flame effect without heat when it is already warm enough inside.
[Safety Protection] Overheating protection automatically shuts the heater off if the internal temperature gets too hot. The TURBRO Suburbs heater is CSA certified to be safe for use in North America.
